title: rcmas: Nash Equilibrium Synthesis for Region-Control Multi-Agent Systems
description: rcmas synthesises pure Nash equilibria of region-control multi-agent systems with the Z3 SMT solver (IBIS, S-IBIS, Q-IBIS and CEGAR-NE, with symmetry reduction), and checks every equilibrium it returns with an independent certifier. This version is the one evaluated in Chapter 7 of the PhD thesis of Steven Jordaan (University of Pretoria). It contains the benchmark territories (grids/), the configuration of the evaluation (experiments/thesis-eval.toml), the result logs (results/), and the scripts that produce every table and figure of the chapter (reproduce.sh, experiments/). README.md, section 'Reproducing the thesis experiments', gives the commands.
